Under the explicit cyclotomic Galois identification, σ_ℓ sends ζ to ζ^ℓ. On the quotient it agrees with the ℓ-power map on the generator and all coefficients, hence everywhere. The quotient is a product of finite fields; the power map preserves each factor, so σ_ℓ stabilizes every prime over ℓ and induces the arithmetic ℓ-power Frobenius on its residue field. Any other automorphism with that action would agree on the residue of ζ; since the reduction has order f and σ_b(ζ)=ζ^b, its exponent b is congruent to ℓ mod f, hence it equals σ_ℓ. For f=1 the group is trivial. No geometric inverse or general Frobenius-lifting theorem is used. Sources inspected: J. S.
